resources.string: Turn on full-screen home to change the home screen settings.
Most cars: 0.5 °C steps, HI at the top.
Choose this if the climate stops at 23.5 instead of HI (1 °C steps).
Follows the car system\'s day and night mode.
The car\'s own bottom bar stays visible.
The car\'s bar is hidden; the launcher\'s own bar is shown.
No bottom bar; the widgets use the full height.
The accent color follows the drive mode.
Always the theme\'s own accent color.
A separate Drive layout appears while moving; the Park layout when stopped.
Move, resize, add or remove widgets directly on the home screen.
Reset the Park layout to the default? Your changes to it will be lost.
Reset the Drive layout to the default? Your changes to it will be lost.
Reset the home screen to the default? Your changes to it will be lost.
The right type for this car is chosen automatically. If AM/FM does not switch, try Type 1 or Type 2.
Short command format. If AM/FM does not switch, try Type 2.
Long command format. If AM/FM does not switch, try Type 1.
The car\'s home button returns to the MapControl home screen. Pressing it there opens the car\'s home screen.
The car\'s home button always opens the car\'s own home screen.
The home screen appears as soon as the app is ready at car startup.
The home screen appears once the car power state is read.
Chosen automatically from the screen size. Applied the next time the home screen opens.
12×6 grid and the current bottom bar. Applied the next time the home screen opens.
12×8 grid and a thin flat bottom bar; layouts are separate from Tiggo 7. Applied the next time the home screen opens.
Vertical screen: car on top, four cards in a 2×2 grid below; the home screen stays in portrait and its layouts are separate. Applied the next time the home screen opens.
In Sport, a chronograph screen opens (Stage layout only).
